p: ["stats card (+11% checkout completion) has warped/embossed text and a distorted ticket shape, reading as a rendering glitch","hook line 'Who' is a sentence fragment split across frames, risking confusion in a fast scroll before the payoff lands","core message (humans point, agents edit, same URL) is only explicit in body copy, not reinforced visually with an actual agent-edit moment"]

The file-write hook and browser-bar reveal read as authentically dev-native, and salience of the Artifact Share badge/URL is consistently strong through every frame. The split-hook device ('wrote checkout-spec.html' / 'Who') is clever but slightly undercuts scroll-stopping power since the punch depends on reading two shots in sequence. The distorted stat card in frame 3 is a visible artifact-quality flaw that could read as sloppy or broken to a skeptical developer audience. CTA and branding close strong and are unambiguous.
